thread:
jason_support: :rotating_light: Customer Hydra reporting large spike of 504s and 5xxs over the last 10m. Support ticket #4239. They say timeouts across multiple API routes. Anyone oncall for hosted gateway?
karen_oncall: I'm on it. Can you paste examples + tenant id? I'll escalate to runtime and platform.
jason_support: Tenant: hydra-prod. Example curl that hits 504s:
```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"long_prompt_repeat_50x"}' \
  https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate
```
We have ~40 tickets from their users. They say errors are intermittent but tail latency huge (20s -> 60s -> 504).
maria_platform: saw the alert — queue depth for hosted-gateway in us-west-2 spiked. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/queues/hydra-prod (link)
ops_incident_bot: Alert: hosted-gateway queue-depth (us-west-2) exceeded soft limit (95th=1.2k, hard=1.5k) at 2026-03-17T14:11:17Z. Continuous-batcher backlog increased 8x.
sam_runtime: I pulled logs for tenant=hydra-prod. We're seeing continuous batching backlog + KV cache spinups delaying dequeues. Key log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T14:09:52Z WARN request_queue.go:412 enqueue depth=1498 max=1500 tenant=hydra-prod
2026-03-17T14:10:03Z ERROR batcher.go:287 batch_build_timeout tenant=hydra-prod delay_ms=12003 queue_len=432
2026-03-17T14:10:18Z ERROR gateway.go:145 downstream=worker-11 status=504 reason="request timeout after queue backpressure"
```
sam_runtime: looks like we hit queue hard-limit and started early rejects + timeouts as the continuous batcher couldn't drain (longseqs kept monopolizing batch windows).
karen_oncall: Any quick mitigation to reduce customer impact? Temporary knobs we can flip?
maria_platform: Two immediate mitigations:
- reduce per-tenant queue limit from 1500 -> 800 for hydra-prod (prevents cluster-wide snowball but will 429 some calls)
- enable fallback to smaller-quantized model variant for hydra (less tokens per call, faster runtime)
I can flip queue limit now if ops approve.
sam_runtime: also we can temporarily disable longseq-prefetch for that tenant so KV cache spinups don't block dequeue. That needs a routing change but is quick.
jason_support: Hydra wants minimal user impact. They'll accept short 429s over 504s. Do it and I'll update ticket.
karen_oncall: go for queue limit reduction + disable longseq-prefetch for hydra-prod. Maria, coordinate with Sam. I'll notify SRE and PagerDuty if it doesn't improve in 5m.
maria_platform: executing change now: `/infra update-tenant-quota --tenant hydra-prod --queue-limit 800` -> running...
deploy-bot: job 9271 started: infra.update-tenant-quota(hydra-prod) by maria_platform
maria_platform: also toggled longseq-prefetch=false for hydra-prod routing -> applied.
ops_incident_bot: Event: quota-change applied for tenant=hydra-prod at 2026-03-17T14:12:08Z. New queue_limit=800.
sam_runtime: seeing immediate drop in queue depth growth and fewer batch-build-timeouts. Realtime trace: p95 queue time down from 14.2s -> 1.6s.
jason_support: customer confirms fewer 504s and front-line users report improved stability. Will keep ticket open until 24h.
karen_oncall: follow-ups:
- Sam to open runtime PR to add tenant-level admission policy with longseq dampening (link to PR requested)
- Maria to propose adaptive soft-limits per tenant to avoid hard limit snowball
- Jason to send customer postmortem + brief FAQ about temporary 429 behavior
sam_runtime: will draft PR titled "tenant-longseq-backpressure" with tests for continuous-batcher fairness.
maria_platform: I'll create runbook entry for "tenant queue-limit mitigation" and add the CLI commands.
jason_support: thanks all. Marking incident as mitigated for now. :thumbsup:
karen_oncall: great work. If metrics re-spike, escalate to cluster-scaling immediately. Closing active pager for now but keeping monitoring window open to 14:40 UTC.
